SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND, PROCE_STATE_CD FROM KEPMPRQ02 WHERE CSTMR_ID IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID='KOL3') AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('RE04','RE05 ','RE06 ') ORDER BY CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT SUBSTR(RQ02.CSTMR_ID,1,10) AS PLANT , RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_NO AS QUOTATION_NO , TO_NUMBER(RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_SEQ) AS QUOTATION_SEQ , RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_RND AS REVISION , DECODE(RQ02.USE_CHK,'N','D','C') AS STATUS , RQ02.GDS_CD AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , RQ03.SLS_UNTPRC AS UNIT_PRICE , substr(RQ03.SPPLR_ID,1,10) AS AGENT , TO_CHAR(ROWNUM,'FM00000') AS AGENT_SEQ , RQ03.SUBID_CHK AS BID_SUCCESS_FLAG , NVL(SUBSTRB(RQ02.ADMNCMPY_NOTE,1,100),' ') AS REMARK , GETALANCINFO(RQ03.SPPLR_ID,'ALANC_NM') AS AGENT_NAME , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS SYS_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS SYS_TIME FROM KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 RQ02, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ04 RQ04, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ03 RQ03 WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$ AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RE_NO AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = RQ04.QUOTA_RE_SEQ AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = RQ04.QUOTA_RE_RND AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_NO AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ = RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_RND = RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_RND AND RQ03.SLS_UNTPRC != 0 AND RQ03.USE_CHK = 'Y' ORDER BY RQ03.SUBID_CHK DESC, RQ03.SLS_UNTPRC, RQ03.SPPLR_ID
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
UPDATE KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
